translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: 2 Timote
book.title: 2 Timote Maktumne ta seeriŋkar taat Pool siiriiji ɗo Timote

content: Askirin̰ kaak taɓ ka Iisa Masi
Gem kol roŋji, iŋ barkin ta gi gastu min ɗo Iisa Masi-an, zeeɗu kii goye bombo.
Kaawin kuuk ki dortu amil min ɗo bir ɗo uŋco ka saadinna ku dakin-ak, gaarcog ɗo gee kuuk ŋu amniyaagu, kuuk nec ɓilde gee ku pey.
Icit taaɓin iŋ nunu ar ki askirin̰ kaak taɓ ka Iisa Masi.
Ya askirin̰ raka a tatkuwiy yaa ozilin̰ji-ak, ŋaa tale riyoy di ho isgigɗo iŋ riy ta gee kuuk askirnaɗo.
Kar ɗo gee kuuk kaasuma iŋ gaɗi, ŋaar kaak pakig een̰ji gasaatɗo haginey ya ŋa bal karmiyin̰ *gaanuun ka gaɗir.
Gay gawnar kaak taaɓiya jelket-jelket ɗo morgoy, ya gamnay nee, illa meen̰ji ja aawaag awalle.
Gem kol roŋji, pakirit samaane kaaw taat nu kaawiijiŋ-anta ho *Rabbin yaan̰ gaaye kii ibine baati okintiti.
Kii pakirguwe ɗo Iisa Masi. Uudin ta Kabarre ta Gala kaawtu, ŋaar min tamba ta sultan Dawuud ho Buŋ nooyig min ɗo muuti. Taar ko Kabarre taat nu gaariy-anta
ho ɗo bi kanti ko, nu taaɓiyiy nam ŋu ɗuuniig pisindu ar nu gem kaak jookumo. Kar kaaw ta Buŋdi gay, ŋu gediraaɗo ɗuuninti.
Ansii ko, nu iciit taaɓin-an okintit ɗo kaar ɗo bi ka ŋuur kuuk Buŋ doɓtu. Paa kat, ŋuur kuuk n̰um iŋ Iisa Masi, ŋuu gase jile ho iŋ *darjin taat gaasɗo tak-tak.
Kaawin kuuk diŋ naan̰ kaawe-aŋ, ŋuur nec gee okin̰co yaa obin̰ bombo :

content.text: « Ya gi mat iŋ Iisa Masi,
Ya gi ica subiraw ɗo taaɓiner,
gii hokumiye iŋ ŋaara ɗo meennuwiy.
Ya gi gina maan kaak iŋ botiliiɗo,
ŋaar gay ginaag doo iŋ botiliy.
Asaan ŋa tatarro ɗo maan kaak meen̰ji kaawtu. »

content: Gay riyor kaak Buŋ oziltu
Kii moyguwin̰ gamin-aŋ ɗo gee kuuk aamine ho kiico kaawe waraŋ iŋ siŋ ku Buŋdi a ŋuu giɗenno ɗo bi ka baaco ta kaawnar di. Giɗaw, taar gaayɗo gem iŋ maanna, illa ta rawtaag ŋuur kuuk cokiyaata.
Zeeɗu, kii peye ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi ar gem kaak tur Buŋ yaa ozile ho ar gay riyor kaak ginno sokan̰ ɗo riyoy ho kaak gaariit kaaw taat ka seener iŋ botilti.
Dak un̰jenno kaan̰ ɗo kaawin kuuk bal baaco ho kuuk kuunayɗo iŋ imaan. Asaan gee kuuk gina ampa-ak, ɗatikco yaa gine serek iŋ Buŋ gaay iŋ gaayo.
Gee ŋuur-ak, ɓildin̰co ar mut kaak gorn̰aw. Min gee-ak goy oki Himene
ho iŋ Pileet.
Ŋuur rasit botol ta taɓ. Ŋu kaawa a Buŋ nooyig ko gee min ɗo muuti.
Ansii ko, ŋu jagiig gee dakina min ɗo imaanco.
Kar gay, gee kuuk aamin ɗo Iisa Masi, ŋuur goy ar dulaayinna ku gerdi. Dulaayinna-ak, Buŋ kat pingu ho ŋu goyiy bombo. Dulaayinna-ak, ŋu siirco aman : « Rabbin Buŋ ibingig geen̰ji ku meen̰ji. »
Ho pey aman : « Ŋaar kaak kaawa a ŋa gem ka Buŋdi-ak, ŋaa etire serek min ɗo gamin kuuk iŋ botilcoɗo. »
Ɗo ger ka gay gamnar, kii gase parkak dakina. Ɗo ƴiriy ta iidiner, ŋu imila parkak ku daabner iŋ ku poddiner. Kar ƴiriy ta maalaŋ gay, ŋu imila parkak kuuk ŋu waƴtu waƴe wala kuuk ŋu pintu pine.

Ansi-ak, gem kaak cal ziy min gamin kuuk jookum-aŋ, ŋaar ar parkak ku iidiner-aŋku. Ŋa gin ko *cawar ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi. Ŋa nec ko ginin riy ta tatkuwiy ɗo botilti. Ho ŋa siy ko ziy ŋaa gine ay riy taat samaane.
Gay riyor ku Buŋdi
Gem kol roŋji, dak un̰jenno zin̰ ɗo ɗubilaw. Kar gay, zeeɗu kii bariye botol ta selliŋkaw, ta imaan, ta elindi ho ta aapiyer iŋ gee kuuk inda Rabbin Buŋ iŋ gelbin kaak *cawar.
Rasit oki meel taat maala, bal baati. Kiŋ iban tam kadar meel, taar iya giɗuwa.
Kar gay riyor ku Rabbin Buŋ gay, ŋuur giɗɗo iŋ gee. Illa gay, ŋuu ginguwe selliŋkaw ɗo gee okin̰co, ŋuu ibine ɓilde gee ho wiktin taat gee osaagu, ŋuu ice subiraw.
Ɗo gee kuuk ooyɗo kaawo, ŋuuco gaarin seene iŋ kaaw taat oola. Paa kat, wal Buŋ yaaco gaaren di botol taat ŋuu ibinin̰ nigin̰co, ŋuu jipte goyin̰co ho ŋuu ibinin seen ta Buŋdi.
Paa kat, kaƴco yaa ase, ŋuu amile min ɗo pise ka *Seetanner kaak obiig awalle ŋu giniy maan kaak ŋa rakiyo.

footnotes.text: ‛Himene’ : Ŋaar ko kaak Pool kaawtu bi ɗo maktumne ta Timote taat awalle (1 Timote 1.20).
‛Ŋu kaawa a Buŋ nooyinte ko’ : Gay raadiner ŋuur-aŋ kaawa a Buŋ nooyaaɗo zi ka gemor, illa ŋa nooya kelim ta gemor ɗo wiktin ta ŋa aamin ɗo Iisa Masi ho ŋa gas goye kaak marbinto.
Wer ka gase kaawor ɗo Nombir 16 : 5.
